FullLegalName.name: Full Legal Name
FullLegalName.definition: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

TradingName.name: Trading Name
TradingName.definition: Name used by a business for commercial purposes, although its registered legal name, used for contracts and other formal situations, may be another.

CountryOfOperation.name: Country Of Operation
CountryOfOperation.definition: Country in which the organisation has its business activity.

RegistrationDate.name: Registration Date
RegistrationDate.definition: Date at which a given organisation was officially registered.

OperationalAddress.name: Operational Address
OperationalAddress.definition: Specifies an operational address, for example, of a shared services centre.

BusinessAddress.name: Business Address
BusinessAddress.definition: Specifies the address where the business activity is taking place.

LegalAddress.name: Legal Address
LegalAddress.definition: Specifies the address where the entity resides and is registered. More generically, it is the home address (Residential address).

BillingAddress.name: Billing Address
BillingAddress.definition: Address where invoices must be sent.

OrganisationIdentification.name: Organisation Identification
OrganisationIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous way of identifying an organisation.

RepresentativeOfficer.name: Representative Officer
RepresentativeOfficer.definition: Person in the customer's organisation who can be contacted by the account servicer in relation to the account(s) identified in this instruction.

TreasuryManager.name: Treasury Manager
TreasuryManager.definition: Person responsible of the treasury department within the customer’s organisation.

MainMandateHolder.name: Main Mandate Holder
MainMandateHolder.definition: Person that has the mandate to delegate authority, to assign mandates to other individuals (mandate holders) to perform specific bank operations on the account.

Sender.name: Sender
Sender.definition: Person that may be the potential sender of a message related to the life cycle of the account.

LegalRepresentative.name: Legal Representative
LegalRepresentative.definition: Person that is officially and legally mandated to represent the organisation. Depending on legislation, the legal representative(s) might for instance be assigned by the Board, identified in the by-laws of the organisation, be publicly announced in the official journal of a country, etc.
